answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each identity to spin a thread of original reasoning that cannot be reused. The thread is checked against prior answers from the same author; a zephyr of independent graders then scores only the fresh mechanism. Reaching a comet of attestation costs one full generation cycle plus external review per identity. Forging many identities therefore costs one complete original construction and jury verification for each, instead of a single cheap template that can be scaled.
